tasks.title: Add `lib/Service/Source/Forge.php` — immutable value object: `id`, `apiBaseUrl`, `webBaseUrl`, `authScheme` (`Bearer`|`token`), `exposesScopeHeader` (bool), `tokenCreateUrl`.
Add `lib/Service/Source/ForgeRegistry.php` (DI singleton) with the `github` and `codeberg` entries from design D1; `get(string $forgeId): Forge` throws on unknown; add `has()`.
Add `authHeaderValue(string $token): string` (or equivalent) so the auth scheme is derived from the `Forge`, not duplicated in callers.
Rename `lib/Service/Source/GithubReleaseSource.php` to `ForgeReleaseSource.php` (class + namespace usage), inject `ForgeRegistry`.

Parameterize the API base (`{forge.apiBaseUrl}/repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases`) and auth header (`Bearer`|`token`) by the binding's forge; keep parsing/dedupe/sort/asset-selection/`.sha256` capture/error humanizing unchanged.
Keep `getInstallerKind()` returning `INSTALLER_EXTERNAL`; keep unauthenticated fallback for public repos on both forges.
Update DI wiring / any references to the old class name.
Retarget the existing GitHub source unit test to `ForgeReleaseSource` (github forge) — behaviour must stay identical.
Add a `forge` discriminator (config field, values `github`|`codeberg`, default `github`) with a `getForge()` accessor, validated to the two values.
Change `getId()` to `"{forge}:owner/repo"`; for `github` keep the exact prior string. Preserve the owner/repo path-traversal regex for both forges.
`fromArray()` reads `forge` (default `github` when absent → legacy compat); `toArray()` always writes `forge`.
Add `SourceBinding::codeberg(owner, repo, assetPattern)` factory mirroring `::github(...)`.
`get()` resolves `KIND_GITHUB_RELEASE` bindings to the single `ForgeReleaseSource` (driver reads forge from binding).
`parseSourceId()` parses `appstore`, `github:owner/repo`, `codeberg:owner/repo`; reject unknown forge prefixes with `InvalidArgumentException`.
`listAvailable()` adds a Codeberg entry (`id: codeberg`, label "Codeberg Releases (public)").
Change matching to compare against the binding's `{forge}:owner/repo` id; patterns are forge-qualified globs.
Normalize a stored bare `owner/repo` pattern (no forge prefix) to `github:owner/repo` before matching.
Change `DEFAULT_PATTERNS` to `['github:ConductionNL/*', 'codeberg:Conduction/*']` (note the org differs per forge).
Preserve `appstore` matching, fnmatch, and path-traversal protections.
Add `protected string $forge = 'github';` to `lib/Db/Pat.php` with `addType('forge','string')`, getter/setter `@method` annotations, and `forge` in `toRedacted()`.

Add `lib/Migration/Version1001Date20260609120000.php` adding column `forge` (`Types::STRING`, length 16, `notnull => true`, `default => 'github'`) to `app_versions_pats`, guarded by `hasColumn` for idempotent re-run.

Make `validate()` accept/derive the forge (default `github`) and read `apiBaseUrl`/`authScheme`/`exposesScopeHeader` from the `Forge`; probe `{apiBaseUrl}/user` with the forge auth header; keep SSRF guard `allow_local_address => false`.
GitHub path unchanged (classic scope enforcement, fine-grained unverifiable-scope, expiry header).

Codeberg path (`exposesScopeHeader=false`): accept valid token with the `unverifiable_scope` warning (Codeberg/Forgejo wording); 401 → "Token is invalid or revoked"; keep token-kind prefix detection GitHub-only.

Add a Codeberg branch returning `url = https://codeberg.org/user/settings/applications` (read from the `Forge` tokenCreateUrl) with Forgejo least-privilege instructions; keep GitHub deeplinks unchanged.
`findFor(...)` matches a PAT's `forge` against the binding's forge in addition to the owner/repo glob; legacy PAT rows (forge `github`) keep serving GitHub bindings.
`ForgeRegistry`: github/codeberg config values; unknown forge throws.
`ForgeReleaseSource` for the codeberg config: lists releases from `codeberg.org/api/v1/...`, normalizes tag/assets, uses `Authorization: token`.
`TrustedSourceList`: forge-qualified match (github + codeberg), untrusted codeberg rejected, legacy-bare → github, cross-forge isolation, default fallback.
`SourceBinding`: codeberg id, legacy load (forge absent → github, id unchanged), path-traversal still rejected.
`SourceRegistry::parseSourceId`: codeberg parsed, unknown forge rejected; `listAvailable` includes codeberg.
`PatValidator`: Codeberg token validated via Forgejo, accepted with unverifiable-scope warning; GitHub path regression unchanged.
`PatResolver`: forge-scoped matching (codeberg PAT ↔ codeberg binding); legacy github PAT still matches github binding.
`composer cs:check` passes (this app has NO `composer check:strict`).
`composer psalm` passes.
`composer test:unit` passes.
Bind a real public Codeberg repo as a source (`codeberg:Conduction/<repo>`), confirm the version list loads.
Install a selected Codeberg release end to end (download + integrity checks + install).
(Optional) Upload a Codeberg access token, confirm it validates with the unverifiable-scope warning and authenticates a private-repo listing.

Migration-upgrade verification: run `occ upgrade` (or re-enable the app), confirm the `forge` column exists on `app_versions_pats`, existing PAT rows read back `forge = github`, and a legacy `github:` binding + legacy GitHub PAT still list versions.
